seo.title: Charsi Restaurant Ajman | Dum Pukht, Namkeen Karahi & Peshawari Food
seo.description: Charsi Restaurant, Sharam Al Sheikh building, behind Brother Gas, New Industrial Area 2, Ajman: Peshawari dum pukht, namkeen and charsi karahi, tikka, Afghani pulao and paya. Open 5 AM to midnight. 4.7 from 3,908 reviews.

hero.lede: Slow-cooked dum pukht, namkeen and charsi karahi, tikka off the coals and Afghani pulao, with fresh atta roti. Open from 5 AM for paya breakfast until midnight. 3,908 Google reviews.
hero.image_alt: Mutton karahi with green chillies and ginger
